description: Minimal capability set for the Partnera Internal OS desktop wrapper. Deny-by-default: the loaded web content (the Partnera admin panel served on loopback) uses NO Tauri IPC. External-link opening, the local runtime, and navigation control are all handled in Rust, so no filesystem, shell, http, process, or opener permission is exposed to web content. Only core window defaults are granted. The `updater` window is a trusted tauri:// page (ui/updater.html) that needs core event listening; note that the updater PLUGIN surface is deliberately NOT granted to any window — the whole check/download/verify/install flow runs in Rust and the window only calls app-owned commands.
